notes.title: Coloring Game 10k Announcement
notes.notes:
I present to you a new game in the [b]Coloring Game[/b] series.
All pictures in [b]Coloring Game 10k[/b] have the same size of 10,000px.

It will be released on August 22nd. 
Images: 90 pcs.
Base price: $6.99 (excluding the launch discount)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759780/Coloring_Game_10K/


Don't forget to subscribe to CG: Girls 3.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525390/Coloring_Game_Girls_3/

notes.title: Coming soon: CG 5 and CG: Girls 2
notes.notes:
We're less than a month away (November 7, 2024) from the Early Access release of the fifth installment of the free-to-play offshoot of the Coloring Game franchise.

[h3]A trailer has been added to the game's page today.[/h3]

[h3]New in the game:[/h3]
[list][*]Ability to upload custom pictures for free (limitation on image size, maximum 125x125 px.);
[*]3D mode;
[*]The game is based on the Coloring Game: Studio core (improved performance relative to previous games in the series).[/list]

Don't forget to add the game to your Wish List and Subscribe to community news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3001970/Coloring_Game_5/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227820/Coloring_Game_51/


Adults add to the wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246900/Coloring_Game_Girls_2/

Great New Year Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34441701/2ea876e24ebd5dbf33f43a849ece788609565656.png[/img]

The free [i]Coloring Game 2[/i] is going to be released on [b]January 10[/b]. 
The DLC which will feature the option of loading user images is currently a work in progress. The release is scheduled for the second half of February. 
The price of the DLC will be [b]$4.99.[/b]

In January the [b]Coloring Game: Pixel[/b] will be complemented with a free update containing 10 new images.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173830/Coloring_Game_Pixel/

Sign up for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/lstotch]developer’s group[/url] so you don’t miss the release of new games!

notes.title: He forgot to write a review.
Release of the Coloring Game: Little City
notes.notes:
The long-awaited free Coloring Game: Little City has finally been released! You’re now able to enjoy 15 free images.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132190/Coloring_Game_Little_City/

The first DLC for the game is going to become available in a week.
[b]Base price: $1.99.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141811/Coloring_Game_Little_City__No1/

Another four DLCs will be released till the end of the year at the same price ($1.99). 

If you’ve decided to purchase the whole additional content for the Coloring Game: Little City, then you’ll be able to do that with a considerable discount thanks to the Season Pass.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141810/Coloring_Game_Little_City__Season_Pass/

Please keep in mind that there will be no discounts for the DLCs for the Coloring Game: Little City in 2019. 

[h1]Don’t forget to leave reviews on the new game! )[/h1]
